scientific_protocol.inheritance: all source, feature, partition, campaign, model, interval, quality-gate, execution and claim fields are loaded from and required bit-identical to the hash-pinned v2 predeclaration

conformal_intervals.specific_impulse: per-stratum symmetric absolute residual normalized by raw epistemic standard deviation
conformal_intervals.quantiles: finite-sample order statistics rounded outward with nextafter

gates.acceptance: every output and scope in every replicate must pass

versioned_delta.v2_failure_fixed: create every output parent before serialization
versioned_delta.atomic_file_policy: same-directory temporary file, flush, fsync, os.replace; remove temporary file on every failure
versioned_delta.model_policy: serialize ExactGP.dumps atomically then reload and require the original model hash
versioned_delta.path_policy: all writes are relative to one declared root; absolute and parent-traversal paths are rejected
versioned_delta.execution_lock_policy: atomically create immutable lock before loading real labels; refuse an existing lock

checks: source config and inherited v2 hashes

claims.allowed: hash integrity and deterministic L0 software-emulation accuracy after successful execution
claims.forbidden: physical, experimental, L1, L1b, L2 or L3 accuracy
